title: Ruby and the Wish Dragon | Read Along | Luna Story Time
description:
Ruby meets Shinebright, a wish dragon, but a wish sends dragons everywhere away from their homes. Ruby must choose her words carefully to give the dragons a choice of where to be.

Book Five of Ruby and the Dragon Bonds. Written with love by Luna and Sunny.

Listen and follow the highlighted words through this illustrated read-along, with a gentle original score.

Read the illustrated book: https://kolatts.github.io/luna-story-time/reader.html?book=ruby-and-the-wish-dragon
